title: Sharing Success-Owning Failure, Chapter 1: Preparing to Command in the Twenty-First Century Air Force
desc: Chapter 1 of 6 of Sharing Success-Owning Failure: Preparing to Command in the Twenty-First Century Air Force, by Col David L. Goldfein (Air University Press, 2001). Then-Colonel Goldfein discusses themes central to a successful squadron command tour, using stories of success and failure to help officers prepare for command. Source: Air University Press audiobook, Air University Public Affairs, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/audio/50690 . Marked public domain on DVIDS; the audio is unaltered.
